name: Clinical text mining
purpose: It addresses the challenge of extracting insights from the vast amount of unstructured textual data in healthcare, such as Electronic Health Records (EHRs), clinical notes, and research articles. This enables healthcare professionals to analyze, interpret, and utilize this data for improved decision-making, research, and patient care.
coreComponents: Natural Language Processing (NLP) Techniques (e.g., tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition)
Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
keyCapabilities: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for medical concepts (e.g., diseases, medications, symptoms)
Relation Extraction to identify connections between entities
Clinical Coding and Standardization (e.g., mapping to SNOMED CT, ICD10)
Text Summarization of clinical notes and documents
Sentiment Analysis to understand patient experiences
integrations: Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards and data warehouses
useCases: Clinical Decision Support and Diagnosis Assistance
Pharmacovigilance and Adverse Drug Event Detection
Patient Risk Stratification and Cohort Identification
